properties.name: Northern valley debris flow
properties.description: The largest flow: a debris flow from a wide scar at the head of the valley north-west of Taw Kye, which ran 700 m south-east down the valley, scouring it to grey sand, and spread over the valley floor where the western channel joins it. Its sediment continues east to the road (TW-OW1) and south into the 2 Oct Taw Kye survey (LS-01).

properties.name: Valley mouth under sediment
properties.description: Fields and scrub at the mouth of the northern valley under grey sand and orange mud from TW-01, up to the road.

properties.name: West Tha Win under sediment
properties.description: The western part of Tha Win, between the foot of the hill and the road, under the sand and debris of the two channels that meet behind the village.

properties.name: North Tha Win under sediment
properties.description: Gardens at the north end of Tha Win under sand from the channel behind them.

properties.name: Paddies east of the road under sediment
properties.description: Paddies east of the road, green on 10 Jan 2026, now under orange mud where the valley flow's sediment crossed the road.

properties.name: Field beside the road under sediment
properties.description: A grass field beside the road at the north edge of the survey under mud washed down from the slides above it (TZ-08); flat ground, so not a slide of its own.
